notes.title: Ending AvaKit Early Access
notes.content:
Announcing the End of AvaKit Early Access

First of all, we'd like to say a huge thanks to all of you who have been using AvaKit.

From CBT to OBT, we've been evolving AvaKit over the past year based on your use and feedback.
With the general availability of AvaKit on April 30, 2024, we have determined that it is difficult to operate and update the Early Access version. 
The early access version will be closed within 90 days after the notice is delivered.

You can try the full version on the official website for one month free of charge for one time only. All services are available during the free trial period.
We ask for your continued interest and support of our service, and we will do our best to reward you with better features and services.

Thank you.

Your AvaKit Development Team

notes.title: Major large-scale AvaKit update is coming!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/94cefceb2b3b133130f7635b2a1f3dae8f12f5b5.png
Hello! This is AvaKit devs. First greeting in 2024!
First of all, we apologize for the late announcement. We've not uploaded any news after Halloween.
However, we are consistently doing our best to develop and improve the AvaKit. Several chronical bugs were fixed and the test with VTubers from Korea and Japan was implemented for update. 🧪

And now, we are announcing some significant news.

AvaKit, what have you been doing? 😣
Prototype of AvaKit was inevitably unstable.
However, the improvement of this unstableness was consistently postponed since we want to grasp what features need to be added and improved in relatively short time. This leads to the accumulation of bugs and small issues and it is internally concluded that AvaKit must be changed from head to toe to provide the best app that we've imagined.

SO THIS UPDATE STARTS
The update details are as follows.

 Design, color, UI
 Improved tracking performance
 More kawaii effects and stickers
 Camera device searching algorithm stability improved
 Optimization
 Miscellaneous fix that only devs will know
 AND... OUR NEW MASCOT, HARU! 🎉


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/9ca35c81919273449e5032135ed4ca5b7505284d.png

How will the new AvaKit be? 🤔
These features will not be applied immediately.

 Smoother and more realistic movement
 Integration with streaming platforms (Twitch, YouTube, etc.)
 Shader and rendering improvement
 Unlimited tracking with just a single camera
 ... and many more secret contents that will flourish your livestreaming

And after finishing the early access, AvaKit will be officially released and it will not be free.
This is an inevitable decision since we want to sustain the AvaKit dev team and develop amazing new features for the wonderful creators here 🙇‍♂️
The precise pricing plan is not decided yet, so we will announce it ASAP whenver it is confirmed.

Release Plan
Based on our rough sketch, the official first version is going to be released in Jan or Feb this year.
We will announce you the accurate date whenver it is confirmed.

+ Will AvaKit support MacOS officially?
We realize that the MacOS support during the early access was ceased at some point since the number of devs in AvaKit team was limited. Whether MacOS will be officially supported will be confirmed after the official release. This is because there are relatively only a few people who use the MacOS version while there are lots of differences in the dev process between MacOS and Windows. (In terms of development, the code structure is little different and the extra process named 'notarization' must be implemented for MacOS version.) Hence, AvaKit dev thought that the development of amazing new features and communication between all of you will be postponed if we decide to support both operation systems. 
However, MacOS support will not be ceased immediately. AvaKit team will analyze the proportion of MacOS users and Windows users and will decide the MacOS version update period.


We'll always try our best to improve AvaKit. Thank you.

Interval for eye blinking
'Interval' is the average time gap for automatic blinking, and the unit is 'second'.
To implement natural movement, 'average' concept (normal distribution) is applied. (For example, if the interval is set '4', then your model might blink randomly once every 3 or 5 seconds.)

Blink Twice
'Blink twice' literally means double-blinking.
We added this feature because people do not always blink exactly once when they blink in real.
The unit is percent(%), which means that your model will always blink once when it is set '0' while your model will always blink twice when it is set '100'.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/e82b5d9e500f67edc3da72f98d9c98eb6a56cdfb.png
Upgraded VMC protocol
Currently, three ways of tracking are available in AvaKit - webcam tracking, perfect sync using iFacialMocap, and VMC protocol.
There are couple of demands related to the precision of VMC protocol, and this update includes the improvement of entire VMC protocol configuration.

Previously, motion data of lower torso from VMC protocol cannot be received since it is worried that it can deter the stability of AvaKit. However, these data are receivable from v1.1.7, which means that the whole body motion data from VMC protocol can be sent to AvaKit. Also, you can select which motion data of specific body parts from head to both legs will be received from v1.1.7, which provides more various options for AvaKit users.

Compatibility with VRM Posing Desktop
VRM Posing Desktop, which is used to implement simple animation or to create precise posing for thumbnails is now compatible with AvaKit. This can be implemented through VMC protocol.

For example, after you strike the pose in VRM Posing Desktop like below,

You can apply several types of shader that AvaKit SDK is being supported to your VRM model in Unity Editor, and can export it as .avakitvrm format. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/6585df6e272c8bc775c7d0c46fbbe445eec12dbe.png
Improvement of camera device detection
There have been several reports about camera detection malfunction from couple of VTuber users. By improving the algorithm related to detecting the camera device, this issue can be resolved from v1.1.4. Also, if the camera is disconnected or the accidental issue occurs at the tracking algorithm, the popup-window will be floated to notify the issue.

 FaceRig Virtual Camera

It is more available to occur some unexpected crash or issues if you use MacOS device and connect lots of virtual cameras and webcams. Please note this point.

Options for tracking performance (resolution, fps)
From v1,1,4, users must set the camera configuration before start tracking in AvaKit. You can choose various options related to tracking performance in the camera setting. You can implement lighter but normal-quality tracking by lowering the resolution and fps, while you can implement heavier but high-quality tracking by heightning the resolution and fps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/eab1a7a06747fa0d1a4c138ddaae3ba9a5613821.png

🚧 Cautions!
The 'resolution' in camera setting is NOT the resolution of your display or the maximum supported resolution of your camera, but the resolution of the video that is being captured by your camera. It regulates the 'size' of the video data.

Higher resolution and frame

 Better tracking performance
 Glitch or latency may occur unless the specification of CPU/GPU is enough
 Heavier CPU/GPU usage

Lower resolution and frame

 Lighter CPU/GPU usage
 Tracking available even if you are using a common, light CPU/GPU
 Relatively worse tracking performance

In addition, you can experience glitch or latency if you use 'MJPEG' format since its default frame rate is relatively high (30). - Higher fps means that the size of the data that should be computed is heavy which leads to high volume of computation. It is recommended to use 'YuY2' format if the performance is not satisfactory. Lastly, there often occurs the error when the resolution is set as 'XRGB'. If the error occurs, please try other resolution options.

notes.title: Notification about later updates
notes.content:
Hello, this is AvaKit devs.
After launching in Steam, lots of VTubers that we'd expected have used AvaKit until now.
Thanks for all of our users, since we know there is still tons of work to be done. 🙇‍♂️

This notification is uploaded to let you know how AvaKit is going to be develooped and updated. As the length of contents will be quite long, I'll summarize the important topic in three lines.

 Three-line summary 
[olist]
 AvaKit update will be once in every two weeks from this update for quality patch.
 Large-scale patch related to applying various type of shader to VRM will be inlcuded in the next update.
 There will be a specific period that focuses only on fixing the bug that all of you have reported to us.
[/olist]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/a01b08ef15a32b0662fd46c608716d491542b971.png
 Why do you expand the update interval? 
Until now, we strictly have implemented weekly update since launching AvaKit as an 'early access' in Steam on 6th May. Although the number of devs is not many, each dev has the highest level of developing skill and is deeply attached to 'VTuber'. That is why we can delightfully enjoy the whole procedure of devleoping AvaKit, and this still remains unchanged.

However, couple of unpredictable bugs and issues occurs as the number of users gets increased, and we determine that juggling to devleop new features that we've imagined and fix existing bugs in a week to be too challenging. The reason is, we normally develop the individual parition that each dev is assigned for four days, implement the internal test before uploading it to Steam for a single day, and check the newly occuring problems and discuss about how to fix it for a couple of days after uploading the updated version.

That is, we, the AvaKit dev realized that large-scaled and time-consuming project (large-scale bug fix like system refactoring, surprisingly new feature, etc.) is being postponed further and further since the actual dev time is just four days as I said above.

How will it be changed?
Update will be implemented once in every two weeks from this update. Therefore, the upcoming new update version will be uploaded in next Friday (21st June, KST), not this Friday or Saturday. By expanding the interval, we expect that the problem solving can be more holistic and efficient so that the frequency of similar bugs can be lower, and interesting new features can be introduced more. Furthermore, users can implement livestreaming with better tracking performance and more flourish contents through AvaKit.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/715d4df8afece33587ff6e59bbe5c13fac4f6c57.png
 What is 'various shaders'? 
As some of you already know, VRM has a problem that the type of shaders that can be applied is limited (PBR, Unlit, MToon).  In case of 3D model used in VRChat, several cool shaders such as lilToon and poiyomi can be applied to the model so that you can express yourself in more various and attractive ways, but you cannot with VRM. For example, if you purchase popular avatar models in Booth that lilToon shader is applied and open the VRM version of him/her, several cool shaders are converted into different, normal shaders. 

To overcome this issue, AvaKit has tried couple of alternatives. As you know, we have changed the rendering pipeline which means the method to render the overall texture of the model, and applied the new Toon shader like a filter in AvaKit. But, we have realized that there are still some limitations. And some of you who know the original figure of your own model may have felt that the appearance of your model becomes different whenever you import your model into AvaKit compared to other software. To address this issue, we have been exloring a method to apply a wider variety of shaders in a holistic and native way by introducing a completely novel approach.

 What kind of update will be implemented? 
As a conclusion, we will introduce a new format(extension) named '.avakit'. But, don't worry! Most of the structure is same as VRM, and the only difference is that '.avakit' model can apply various type of shaders! If the idea that we are planning are successfully included in the next update patch, it is expected that the followings can be avaliable.

 It is possible to apply various shaders like lilToon and UnitychanToon in your model.
 It is possible to apply multiple type of shaders in a single model.
 It may not be availble soon, but it would be possible to use your fascinating VRChat avatar as it is in AvaKit!

AvaKit dev will try our best to make you show your own charm in AvaKit in best ways.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/334ab09af63c765274a8332b08881f0a7171c409.png
What is a 'debugging period'?
Developing and updating AvaKit for about two months, more than 2,000 VTubers from 70 countries have used AvaKit. Sincerly thanks for your love to AvaKit. 🙇‍♂️

Even though we can juggle rapidly fixing bugs and issues that are reported by users and developing users that can make AvaKit cooler, lots of bug-fixing assignments are accumulated with bug reports received every morning to midnight. Since every report is precious and important for us, the 'debugging period' which is a period (two-week) that focuses only on resolving the existing issues and problems will be implemented after the next update to make more VTubers use AvaKit more easily and comfortably.

The result of debugging period is planned to be uploaded through v1.1.5, and it will last for two weeks from 24th July. Within this preiod, new feature will not be developed to concentrate on bug-fixing.

 ~ 21st Jul New feature update and miscalleneous bug fixing
 21st Jul v1.1.4 update (planned)
 22nd Jul ~ 4th Aug debugging period
 4th Aug v1.1.5 update (planned)


Thanks for reading the long article.
We'll always try our best to improve AvaKit. Thank you.

notes.content:
We executed middle-scale update based on your feedbacks for v1.0.6-alpha.
The performance of iFacialMocap-based perfect sync that was introduced in the previous version and overall tracking of AvaKit is dramatically improved - minimized tracking issues such as strange movement and instant wiggling.
Your feedbacks are really helpful to develop better AvaKit 🙇‍♂️

New features
Support expansion for iFacialMocap-based perfect sync
In the previous version, all 52 blendshapes should be prepared to start perfect sync in AvaKit, but now you can use iPhone-based facial tracking even if not all of the blendshapes are prepared. (But, we recommend to prepare all of them to implement it smoothly.)

Improved texture rendering

notes.title: AvaKit 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
AvaKit 1.0.0 version (initial version) has a problem that it spends too much time to discover the connected webcam device, or even cannot find the device. Also, the camera name shown at the display is just 'camera 1', 'camera 2', and so on, instead of its camera name even after it finds the device, which makes it harder for users to decide which camera device to choose.

This issue was related to the way of discovering the USB device, and this update patch can drastically reduce the time to discover your device. After several tests, the average time spent is about 5 to 10 seconds, and the max time spent was about 2 minutes. Also, the device name can be shown intuitively.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43977778/5690fac80bc65dd6d738ba99649cc870e0730c47.png

Also, there was a shortkey-related issue - The virtual keyboard when assigining the shortcut is colored when it is assigned and it goes to initial state when it is unassigned, but the virtual keyboard did not go to initial state even after it is unassigned. This bug is fixed. 

Please feel free to say about issues that you faced or suggestion that you think of to us at the AvaKit Official Discord Server. We are looking forward to seeing you!
